title: The Illusion of Certainty: Uncertainty Quantification for LLMs Fails under Ambiguity
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical aspects of uncertainty quantification and ambiguity in Large Language Models. It introduces new datasets (MAQA* and AmbigQA*) to evaluate these technical properties. While it mentions high-stakes deployment domains like medicine and law, it does not evaluate religion, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethical frameworks.
